name: Flippa
summary: Marketplace for buying and selling online businesses, SaaS, apps and domains. Self-serve, so the due diligence is yours.
best_for: buyers and sellers of small-to-mid online businesses, SaaS, apps and domains who want the largest marketplace and are comfortable doing their own due diligence
skip_if: you're selling a large, premium business where a dedicated broker's vetting and negotiation earns its higher fee, or you want a hands-off sale
honest_knock: The real cost is the success fee, and it's a flat bracket rate on the whole sale price, not marginal: a mid-five-figure sale can hand over a four- to five-figure commission. Flippa is also a self-serve marketplace: more listings, but more due-diligence burden on you. Verification and quality vary, so buyers must vet hard and sellers should expect tyre-kickers. It's reach and liquidity, not a white-glove broker.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-03 on their own pricing page, USD, and unchanged band by band on 2026-09-29) Sellers pay an upfront listing fee plus a success fee when the business sells, and BOTH change with the asking-price band. The success fee is 10% on every band up to $499.9K, then 9% from $500K, 8% from $1M, 7% from $5M, 6% from $10M and 5% at $50M+. The listing fee is not one figure either: on a sub-$10K asset it is $29 flat for a 60-day term, $49 flat for a boosted three-month listing, or $199 per six months for Premium; from $10K the ladder is $49, $399 or $599 per six months; from $50K it is $129, $399 or $699. From $100K upward there is no self-service option at all — Flippa routes those to its own brokers at a single upfront $399 to $1,499 for a six-month brokerage term, with the success fee still on top. Buyers browse free — AI matching, Deal Room, FlippaPay, escrow and multi-currency are all included — and a paid buyer subscription ($49 a month or $490 a year, up from $388 a year in our July and August 2026 captures) adds 21 days of exclusive early access to new listings valued over $10,000. Payment charges are published too: FlippaPay from 1% and Escrow.com from 1.2%.

exit_test.what: No account was needed; the tool ran without signing in. On 18 November 2026 the session searched Flippa without an account. The filter $10K - $100K with Monthly Profit: $1+ gave 1,235 results for websites, FBA, SaaS and ecommerce and 193 for apps and SaaS only. Cards and listing pages show the asking price, profit and multiples without a login, while detailed traffic, financials and seller notes ask for a free account and confidential listings ask for an NDA. The seller prices are the same as in the dossier: Entry $29, Boosted $49 and Premium $199 on a sub-$10K asset, a 10% success fee, and the broker route at $399 for $100K - $249.9K and $899 for $500K - $999.9K. The 60-day term of Entry could not be read in full because a cookie banner covered it. Nothing was clicked on a Sell button and nothing was bought. Account and start: no account was used. Our AI assistant ran the test in a tab of our Chrome on flippa.com, with no login (the interface is in English, prices in USD). Nothing was bought, no offer or message was made, no valuation was asked for and no e-mail address was entered. The dossier name is Flippa and the review is on OSM (osm/flippa-review.html). The test date is 18 Nov 2026; the start time was not recorded in the notes. Start: searching worked at once without a login. A Cloudflare security check appeared when a listing was opened and went away by itself after about 5 seconds; there was no CAPTCHA and no click was needed. Search 1: websites, FBA, SaaS and ecommerce with the price $10K - $100K and Monthly Profit: $1+ gave Showing 1-50 of 1,235. Search 2: only apps and SaaS with the same price and profit filter gave Showing 1-50 of 193 (on the first page 25 SaaS, 20 iOS App and 5 Android App). A card without a login shows the asking price (often with an older price struck through and Reduced 27%), Monthly Revenue, Monthly Profit, Profit Multiple, Age, Type, Industry, the country, the label Data Verified, and Marketplace, Listed by Owner or Brokered by Flippa. Example: an Android translator app at USD $84,490, Monthly Revenue USD $4.05K, Monthly Profit USD $3.88K, Profit Multiple 1.8x. A listing page without a login (a SaaS for Amazon authors) shows Monthly Profit, Profit Margin 75%, Page Views, Profit Multiple 2.1x, Revenue Multiple 1.6x, MRR, subscribers, churn 6%, the full description and Vetted + Data Verified Listing. Behind a login or an NDA: Create your account to view detailed information, including traffic, financials and seller notes, with the button SIGN UP FOR FREE; for a Confidential listing Confidential Sign NDA to view; Inquire Now and Make Offer ask for an account. Some listings are First Access: Purchase First Access to view this listing before everyone else. Goes public on Dec 05, 2026. The tester did not try a separate verified revenue filter; the label Data Verified is on many cards but not on all. Seller prices: flippa.com/pricing, read by the tester on 18 Nov 2026 in US dollars with the slider on the asking price. Sub $10K, Self-Service: Entry $29 (the term line was partly covered by the cookie banner: only 0-day term could be read, presumably 60 days), Boosted $49 Flat Fee three-month term (Most Picked) and Premium $199 per 6 months (NDA protection), all with a 10% success fee. $100K - $249.9K: only Sell with a dedicated Flippa M&A Broker, $399, 6-month brokerage term, single upfront payment, success fee paid only when your business sells, 10% success fee. $500K - $999.9K: $899 and a 9% success fee. The slider started on $250K - $499.9K: $499 and 10%. The buyer subscription ($49 a month) was not seen. The prices seen are the same as in the dossier, so the price is UNCHANGED; the 60 days of Entry could not be read in full. Nothing was clicked on any Sell button. Cancelling: not applicable, there is no account. Not tested: logging in, bidding, signing an NDA, a valuation, the paid buyer subscription, buying First Access and the real price after clicking Sell now. Clean up: no account and nothing created; the own tab was closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The financials, traffic and seller notes of a listing need a free account and a confidential listing needs an NDA, so a buyer has to sign up before judging a deal in depth. The term of the Entry plan was partly covered by the cookie banner. The label Data Verified is not on every card. The success fee is on top of the listing fee.

exit_test.what: No account was needed; the tool ran without signing in. On 18 November 2026 the session searched Flippa without an account. The filter $10K - $100K with Monthly Profit: $1+ gave 1,235 results for websites, FBA, SaaS and ecommerce and 193 for apps and SaaS only. Cards and listing pages show the asking price, profit and multiples without a login, while detailed traffic, financials and seller notes ask for a free account and confidential listings ask for an NDA. The seller prices are the same as in the dossier: Entry $29, Boosted $49 and Premium $199 on a sub-$10K asset, a 10% success fee, and the broker route at $399 for $100K - $249.9K and $899 for $500K - $999.9K. The 60-day term of Entry could not be read in full because a cookie banner covered it. Nothing was clicked on a Sell button and nothing was bought. Account and start: no account was used. Our AI assistant ran the test in a tab of our Chrome on flippa.com, with no login (the interface is in English, prices in USD). Nothing was bought, no offer or message was made, no valuation was asked for and no e-mail address was entered. The dossier name is Flippa and the review is on OSM (osm/flippa-review.html). The test date is 18 Nov 2026; the start time was not recorded in the notes. Start: searching worked at once without a login. A Cloudflare security check appeared when a listing was opened and went away by itself after about 5 seconds; there was no CAPTCHA and no click was needed. Search 1: websites, FBA, SaaS and ecommerce with the price $10K - $100K and Monthly Profit: $1+ gave Showing 1-50 of 1,235. Search 2: only apps and SaaS with the same price and profit filter gave Showing 1-50 of 193 (on the first page 25 SaaS, 20 iOS App and 5 Android App). A card without a login shows the asking price (often with an older price struck through and Reduced 27%), Monthly Revenue, Monthly Profit, Profit Multiple, Age, Type, Industry, the country, the label Data Verified, and Marketplace, Listed by Owner or Brokered by Flippa. Example: an Android translator app at USD $84,490, Monthly Revenue USD $4.05K, Monthly Profit USD $3.88K, Profit Multiple 1.8x. A listing page without a login (a SaaS for Amazon authors) shows Monthly Profit, Profit Margin 75%, Page Views, Profit Multiple 2.1x, Revenue Multiple 1.6x, MRR, subscribers, churn 6%, the full description and Vetted + Data Verified Listing. Behind a login or an NDA: Create your account to view detailed information, including traffic, financials and seller notes, with the button SIGN UP FOR FREE; for a Confidential listing Confidential Sign NDA to view; Inquire Now and Make Offer ask for an account. Some listings are First Access: Purchase First Access to view this listing before everyone else. Goes public on Dec 05, 2026. The tester did not try a separate verified revenue filter; the label Data Verified is on many cards but not on all. Seller prices: flippa.com/pricing, read by the tester on 18 Nov 2026 in US dollars with the slider on the asking price. Sub $10K, Self-Service: Entry $29 (the term line was partly covered by the cookie banner: only 0-day term could be read, presumably 60 days), Boosted $49 Flat Fee three-month term (Most Picked) and Premium $199 per 6 months (NDA protection), all with a 10% success fee. $100K - $249.9K: only Sell with a dedicated Flippa M&A Broker, $399, 6-month brokerage term, single upfront payment, success fee paid only when your business sells, 10% success fee. $500K - $999.9K: $899 and a 9% success fee. The slider started on $250K - $499.9K: $499 and 10%. The buyer subscription ($49 a month) was not seen. The prices seen are the same as in the dossier, so the price is UNCHANGED; the 60 days of Entry could not be read in full. Nothing was clicked on any Sell button. Cancelling: not applicable, there is no account. Not tested: logging in, bidding, signing an NDA, a valuation, the paid buyer subscription, buying First Access and the real price after clicking Sell now. Clean up: no account and nothing created; the own tab was closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The financials, traffic and seller notes of a listing need a free account and a confidential listing needs an NDA, so a buyer has to sign up before judging a deal in depth. The term of the Entry plan was partly covered by the cookie banner. The label Data Verified is not on every card. The success fee is on top of the listing fee.
